The proposed answer is almost certainly wrong. The question asks for an exact numerical value of α that is universal across all dimensions d ≥ 2. The answer d/2 depends on d, so it cannot satisfy that requirement.

The cited source also doesn't check out. I'm not aware of a Gwynne paper with that title, and I can't verify the claimed result. The proposed reasoning gives no derivation of the exponent, only an appeal to "established results," so it doesn't support d/2.

I can't confidently state the correct value of α from memory, so I'm not offering a replacement. What is clear is that a dimension-dependent answer contradicts the problem's premise.

VERDICT: REJECT
